Train2#2.zh: 喔！这不是史进吗？%X兄也在... 啊！林冲，你怎么也来了...
Train2#2.t: Oh! Isn't this Shi Jin? And Brother %X too... Ah! Lin Chong, you've come as well...

Train2#4.zh: 林冲将高衙内看上林夫人、白虎节堂遭陷、野猪林的暗杀、以及主角们仗义相助的来龙去脉都向王进说了。
Train2#4.t: Lin Chong told Wang Jin the whole story: Young Master Gao's designs on Lady Lin, the trap at White Tiger Hall, the attempt on his life at Wild Boar Forest, and how the heroes had stood by him.

Train2#5.zh: 唉～我所担心的事终究还是发生了。
Train2#5.t: Sigh~ what I feared has happened after all.

Train2#6.zh: 不过这样也好，至少我不用再在那卑鄙小人的手下做事了，妻子和家人也都送到了安全的地方；倒是王大哥，高俅已经知道你在延安府了，我们都很担心他会来加害于你...
Train2#6.t: But it's better this way. At least I no longer serve under that despicable man, and my wife and family are somewhere safe. It's you we're worried about, Brother Wang. Gao Qiu knows you're in Yan'an, and we fear he'll come after you...

Train2#7.zh: 哈哈...这我倒不担心，我已经躲开他那么远了，我相信他不会再来找我麻烦...不谈这个了，来了那么多的好汉，怎么不帮我介绍一下。
Train2#7.t: Haha... that doesn't worry me. I've got far enough away from him; I don't think he'll trouble me again... Enough of that. So many heroes have come; won't you introduce me?

Train2#8.t: Brother Wang, let me introduce them. This is....

Train2#9.zh: 当下%N将晁盖、公孙胜、阮氏兄弟等众人一一介绍给王进，双方相互寒喧了一番，皆是惺惺相惜、相见恨晚。
Train2#9.t: %N introduced Chao Gai, Gongsun Sheng, the Ruan brothers and the rest to Wang Jin one by one. They exchanged greetings and took to each other at once, each regretting they hadn't met sooner.

Train2#10.zh: 对了！前些日子我又研究出一套功夫，谁有兴趣与我切磋切磋？
Train2#10.t: Oh, right! I've worked out a new set of moves lately. Anyone care to spar with me?

Train2#11.zh: 哈哈！王兄真是嗜武成痴啊！
Train2#11.t: Haha! Brother Wang, you're truly obsessed with martial arts!

Train2#38.zh: 大家就暂且在此盘桓几天再走吧！也好让我略尽一下地主之谊。
Train2#38.t: Stay here a few days before you go! Let me play the host a little.

Train2#39.zh: 不瞒王兄，大伙正要上梁山泊投靠，咱们都是朝廷重赏的钦犯，只怕在此多呆要累了王兄...
Train2#39.t: To be honest, Brother Wang, we're on our way to seek refuge at Liangshan Marsh. We're all wanted by the court with big bounties on us; if we stay long, we'll only drag you into it...

Train2#40.zh: 嗳～！什么拖累不拖累的事，%X兄从此以后休要再提起；大伙儿今日不醉个三天三夜的话，我王进是不会放你们走的！
Train2#40.t: Come now~! No more talk of dragging anyone into anything, Brother %X. Unless we all get drunk for three days and nights, I, Wang Jin, won't let you go!

Train2#42.zh: 短暂的平静是不是风波的先兆呢？
Train2#42.t: Is this brief calm the sign of a coming storm?
